site_name: Trellick Tower, 5 Golborne Road, LONDON, W10 5PA
description: Refurbish residential entrance and regenerate Trellick Tower Complex, restoring lobby and foyer, updating it to modern standards and building regulation requirements. Refurbish space to make it fit for purpose. Installation of two entrance doors. Exposure of original coffered ceiling to ground floor foyer involving removal of hung ceiling.  Installation of entrance desk which meets security, access and Covid requirements and is in-keeping with interior design ethos. Clarity of material palette, reinstating original finishes with clear definition of in-keeping modern intervention. Installation of timber wall cladding to cover areas of wall which were not in-keeping and provide an area for controlled signage and billboards.
